notes.title: FOOL'S PARADISE DEMO 2.0 NOW OUT!
notes.content:
Thank you so much for your patience with us! We are happy to announce the release of the new demo! This update completely reworks the original demo to reflect the quality of our current work for the rest of Act 1. 

[b]PATCH NOTES[/b]
    [list]
[*] Reworked narrative with concise dialogue and descriptions. 
[*]     Coding for sprites has been completely redone from the bottom up. 
[*]     Additional outfit for Tempest. 
[*]     Added new backgrounds alongside adjustments to certain ones. 
[*]     Reworked UI. 
[*]     Added a map UI that unlocks on December 5th. This menu is used to help the player clarify the layout of the commune as a reference. 
[*]     Added a splash screen. 
[*]     Ending screens have more flair, with scrolling credits. 
[*]     Reduced visual screen-shaking. 
[*]     Adjusted the after-quiz section to fit the computer UI. 
[*]     Something strange is seen through the commune now… Are your eyes deceiving you? 
[/list]

Have any feedback? Feel free to comment on the game’s page, make a post, or join our Discord server (https://discord.com/invite/ZE6csvV9sr).

notes.title: MINI UPDATE: Steam Achievements and Bugs
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891989/25c2c7288dc95cd71a030cda9b8159f9fb04ef41.png[/img]

[h1]PATCH NOTES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Achievements should work on Steam now! Apologies for the delays with this bug.
[*]Fixed a bug with a certain garden ending.
[*]Added credits for Beta Testers. Thank you so much for your help with testing the game!
[*]Cleaned up the files. Removed unnecessary baggage on the build, helping to reduce the amount of storage the game takes.
[*]Memory Usage. Added some bits of code to help with the game's memory usage. 
[*]Font Flair. Changed some parts to a different font, fitting the context better.
[*]Small Adjustments to Sprites. Flipped certain sprites to make all of them face the person they are talking to. 
[/list]

[h1]UPCOMING PATCH NOTES[/h1]
[list]
[*] With the demo's major issues tuned out, we will now use this time to adjust small text typos in the near future. This will be a quiet patch!
[/list]
